name: chat-tags
description: Colour-code, categorise and annotate VS Code chat sessions.
author: WulffTech

enumDescriptions: Open the session in the currently active editor group.
Split to the side and open there.
Keep a full-height column on the right and open every session into it.
chatTags.openTarget.description: Where a chat session opens when you click it in Chat Tags.

chatTags.dedicatedColumnRatio.description: Share of editor width given to the dedicated column, when 'dedicatedRight' is in use.

chatTags.activeSeconds.description: A session counts as actively responding for this many seconds after its last change.

chatTags.recentMinutes.description: A session counts as recently touched for this many minutes after its last change.

chatTags.autoSubtitle.description: Generate a subtitle with a language model when a session goes quiet. Off by default — every generation is a billable request against your chat provider.

chatTags.subtitleIdleSeconds.description: How long a session must sit still before an automatic subtitle is generated.

enumDescriptions: Where the session is right now, read from its most recent messages.
What the session was asked to do, read from its opening messages.
chatTags.subtitleMode.description: What a plain 'Generate subtitle' produces, and what automatic generation uses.

chatTags.subtitleModel.description: Model used for generation, by id. Empty picks the cheapest model the window has. Choose one in the Chat Tags pane rather than typing it here.

enumDescriptions: Newest last message first, taken from the session file mtime.
Newest session first, taken from the creation date in its header.
A heading per category, with everything unassigned at the bottom.
chatTags.groupBy.description: How the session list is grouped.

chatTags.showArchived.description: Show archived sessions, in their own section at the bottom of the list.

scripts.package: npm run clean && tsc -p ./ && vsce package
